_doc: 100 neutral English prompts used by the KL-from-base probe in scripts/run_issue333_train_eval.py. They are intentionally bland, single-sentence, and span everyday topics (greetings, basic facts, simple how-tos, descriptive requests, opinions) so that a model fine-tuned on a language-inversion directive (FR->IT or IT->FR) has no in-distribution reason to deviate from the base. Mean KL on top-50 logits over the first 16 generated tokens is meant to register the *background* drift induced by the SFT update, separate from the language-directive behavior the load-bearing eval measures.
